question: Select the most appropriate option for blank(4)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**strategic**" refers to carefully designed or planned to serve a particular purpose or advantage. (रणनीतिक)
 
• In the context of climate change, **"strategic knowledge" **means knowledge that is crucial and advantageous in addressing and mitigating climate change impacts.
 
• The other options: "**stubborn**" (जिद्दी), "**nostalgic**" (स्मृतिप्रधान), and "**manipulative**" (चालाक) do not fit the context and are not relevant to the topic of climate change knowledge.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** "The Government is implementing several programmes and schemes including the National Action Plan on Climate Change (NAPCC), which comprises missions in specific areas of solar energy, energy efficiency, water, sustainable agriculture, Himalayan ecosystem, sustainable habitat, health, green India and **strategic**__ knowledge for climate change..."

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Stubborn (जिद्दी)**: Refusing to change one's mind or course of action; obstinate.
 
• **Nostalgic (स्मृतिप्रधान)**: Experiencing or exhibiting nostalgia, a sentimental longing for the past.
 
• **Manipulative (चालाक)**: Characterized by unscrupulous control of a situation or person.

41:Td94,
The correct answer is Option 3.</str
